crossRefs.note: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.

He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds…
Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows…

translations.web: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
translations.bsb: Below the rim, ornamental buds encircled it, ten per cubit all the way around the Sea, cast in two rows as a part of the Sea.
translations.kjv: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
translations.asv: And under the brim of it round about there were knops which did compass it, for ten cubits, compassing the sea round about: the knops were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
